Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. President Reagan makes largest allocation yet for AIDS research in 1987 2. Tom Chorlton plans to resign from his post as head of the National Association of Gay and Lesbian Democratic Clubs 3. Flight attendant with AIDS grounded due to possibility of spread through casual contact COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. Florida state Representative, Byron Combee resigns after being caught touching an undercover police officer in a lewd manner in a public park 5. Chicago, "gay dollars" are in wide distribution, despite the efforts of certain banks to destroy the marked dollars COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 6. Sale of condoms has dramatically risen 7. Part one of report on two new tests for AIDS infection COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 8. Sports Report 9. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Review of "Nunsense" off-Broadway show, with clips COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. Interview with director, Phil Zwickler COMMERCIAL: The World of Video VHS store 4. Coverage of the fundraising event, "22 on the Red" COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation, with Jose Sarria 5. Just Ask Raz advice segment
